golden-testing/com.google.maps.android.testing.golden/GoldenTileProvider

GoldenTileProvider

class GoldenTileProvider(val strategy: GoldenTileStrategy = GoldenTileStrategy.CoordinateGrid(), val tileSize: Int = 256, cacheSize: Int = 128) : TileProvider

A TileProvider that serves deterministic synthetic raster tiles for Google Maps SDK screenshot and golden image testing.

Replaces remote network-fetched map tiles with locally computed bitmaps generated by GoldenTileStrategy. Built-in LRU caching avoids re-rasterization and PNG re-compression during map panning, zooming, and camera transitions.

Parameters

strategy

The GoldenTileStrategy to use for tile generation. Defaults to GoldenTileStrategy.CoordinateGrid.

tileSize

Dimension in pixels for tile width and height. Standard Web Mercator is 256.

cacheSize

Maximum number of compressed tile byte arrays to retain in memory. Defaults to 128.
